No, Express shipping isn't available for island addresses. Island and remote addresses fall under Zone 3, and Express isn't offered there.

Your option is Standard shipping, which takes 5-8 business days to Zone 3. It costs $7.95, or is free on orders of $75 or more (after discounts, before tax). Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so an order placed after 12 noon Wednesday ships the following Monday.

Do you want help with anything else on your order?
